description: This file implements utilities for versioning and hashing source files and build arguments for extending C++ modules in PyTorch. It defines a namedtuple for entries, functions for hashing source files and build arguments, and a class ExtensionVersioner that manages versioning based on source and build changes.

classes.name: ExtensionVersioner
classes.description: A class that manages versioning information for C++ extension modules based on source files and build parameters.

methods.name: update_hash(seed, value)
methods.description: Combines a seed value with a new value to produce a combined hash, similar to boost::hash_combine.

methods.name: hash_source_files(hash_value, source_files)
methods.description: Computes a cumulative hash of a list of source files by reading their contents.

methods.name: hash_build_arguments(hash_value, build_arguments)
methods.description: Computes a hash of build argument groups, combining each argument's hash.

methods.name: get_version(self, name)
methods.description: Retrieves the current version number for a specific extension identified by name.

methods.name: bump_version_if_changed( self, name, source_files, build_arguments, build_directory, with_cuda, with_sycl, is_python_module, is_standalone, )
methods.description: Calculates hashes based on source files and build parameters, updates the version if changes are detected.

ctags.name: bump_version_if_changed
ctags.signature: ( self, name, source_files, build_arguments, build_directory, with_cuda, with_sycl, is_python_module, is_standalone, )
